import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

def task_func(P, T):
    P = np.asarray(P)
    T = np.asarray(T)

    if P.ndim != 2 or T.ndim != 3:
        raise ValueError("P must be a 2D matrix and T must be a 3D tensor.")

    if P.shape[1] != T.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError(
            "Incompatible shapes for matrix-tensor multiplication: "
            f"P.shape={P.shape}, T.shape={T.shape}."
        )

    product = np.matmul(P, T)  # Shape: (T.shape[0], P.shape[0], T.shape[2])
    flattened = product.reshape(product.shape[0], -1)

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    normalized = scaler.fit_transform(flattened)

    columns = [f"feature_{i}" for i in range(normalized.shape[1])]
    return pd.DataFrame(normalized, columns=columns)
